intro.line: Long ago, humanity lived in both the physical and digital worlds.
intro.detail: Questions, arguments, experiences and judgments accumulated deep inside the network.

intro.line: Then human civilization disappeared from this place.
intro.detail: Cities fell silent and coastlines emptied, but the cognitive archive preserved by Zhihu kept running.

intro.line: At some unknown moment, the digital world overlapped with the surviving material world.
intro.detail: Cities, oceans, forests and ruins were reshaped by questions and opinions.

intro.line: The unfinished questions of old humanity gained gravity.
intro.detail: Neighboring questions pulled on one another, and unresolved debates kept echoing in the dark.

intro.line: Questions formed galaxies. Opinions condensed into planets.
intro.detail: Answers, reasons, conditions and evidence sank into their surfaces as relics of civilization.

intro.line: This is not a place of answers. It is a lost universe.
intro.detail: Seeker, continue along the questions they never finished.
